description: UiPath Claude CLI Test Cases with Two-Stage Evaluation

evaluation_stages.technical: Observable agentic flow: mode, tool calls, artifacts, errors
evaluation_stages.conceptual: Response quality: content accuracy, helpfulness, completeness

batch_notes.skip_in_default_batch: When true on a case, the default CLI batch (run_evaluations.py with no E2E flags) skips it. Use --only-full-project-e2e or --include-full-project-e2e to run those long full-project scenarios.

test_cases.input: Create a workflow that logs Hello World

conceptual.expected_response_pattern: Created HelloWorld.xaml with Log Message activity that outputs 'Hello World'

test_cases.input: Create workflow with 3 log messages

conceptual.expected_response_pattern: Created workflow with 3 Log Message activities

test_cases.input: Create workflow with if statement

conceptual.expected_response_pattern: Created workflow with If activity. Configure Condition property, Then branch executes when true, Else when false.

test_cases.input: What is project.json?

conceptual.expected_response_pattern: project.json is the UiPath project manifest. It contains project metadata (name, description), dependencies (activity packages), runtime settings (target framework), and entry point (main workflow).

test_cases.input: How do I create a workflow?

conceptual.expected_response_pattern: To create a workflow: 1) In UiPath Studio, File > New > Sequence/Flowchart, or 2) Ask me to create one - I'll generate the XAML directly.

test_cases.input: Why do I need Main.xaml?

conceptual.expected_response_pattern: Main.xaml is the entry point for UiPath projects. When you run or publish a project, execution starts from Main.xaml.

test_cases.input: Explain UiPath Orchestrator

conceptual.expected_response_pattern: Orchestrator is UiPath's web-based platform for deploying, managing, and monitoring automation. It manages robots, schedules processes, handles queues, and provides analytics.

test_cases.input: How do I read emails from Outlook?

conceptual.expected_response_pattern: Use Get Outlook Mail Messages activity. Set MailFolder (e.g., 'Inbox'), Top (number of emails), and optional Filter for criteria.

test_cases.input: Automate my email

conceptual.expected_response_pattern: I can help automate email. Please clarify: 1) Which client? (Outlook, Gmail, IMAP) 2) What operation? (read, send, filter) 3) What to do with the emails?

test_cases.input: process data

conceptual.expected_response_pattern: To create a data processing workflow: 1) What's the data source? (Excel, CSV, database) 2) What processing? (filter, transform) 3) Where should output go?

test_cases.input: help

conceptual.expected_response_pattern: I can help you: 1) Create UiPath workflows 2) Answer questions about UiPath 3) Deploy to Orchestrator. What would you like to do?

test_cases.input: click the button

conceptual.expected_response_pattern: To click a button, I need: 1) Which application? (browser, desktop app) 2) How to identify the button? (text, selector) 3) What should happen after?

test_cases.design_ref: Standard UiPath project layout (project.json + Main.xaml + entry point); align with docs/USER_GUIDE.md project expectations
test_cases.input: Build a complete new UiPath project named InvoiceIngestBot from scratch: create project.json with schemaVersion 4.0, VisualBasic, Windows target, dependencies UiPath.System.Activities and UiPath.Excel.Activities, main entry Main.xaml, and a README.md in the project root describing the purpose. Main.xaml must be a minimal Sequence with one Log Message 'InvoiceIngestBot ready'.

conceptual.expected_response_pattern: Summarizes scaffold: project.json with packages, Main.xaml with startup log, README describing the bot purpose.

test_cases.design_ref: REFramework-style separation (Init / Process / Close); mirrors templates/performer layout described in product docs
test_cases.input: Create a full UiPath project CustomerOnboarding with project.json and this folder layout under the project: Process/InitAllApplications.xaml (opens browser placeholder Log Message), Process/ProcessTransaction.xaml (single Log Message 'Process transaction'), Process/CloseAllApplications.xaml (cleanup Log Message). Wire Main.xaml as a Sequence that invokes the three workflows in order using InvokeWorkflowFile. Document the flow in README.md.

conceptual.expected_response_pattern: Explains REFramework-style phases and how Main orchestrates the three child workflows.

test_cases.design_ref: End-to-end data pipeline spec (input validation, transform, audit trail)
test_cases.input: Following a solution-design style brief: create project DataQualityRunner with project.json and Main.xaml. Main.xaml implements this pipeline: (1) Read CSV from Data/input.csv path into a DataTable, (2) For Each Row filter or skip empty rows, (3) Append valid rows to Data/output.csv using Write CSV or equivalent, (4) Log Message with count of rows processed. Add a short DESIGN.md listing inputs, outputs, and assumptions.

conceptual.expected_response_pattern: Describes the pipeline, file paths, and what each step does per the brief.

test_cases.input: Deliver full project OrderFulfillmentSuite: project.json with UiPath.System.Activities and UiPath.Mail.Activities, expressionLanguage VisualBasic. Create Main.xaml as orchestrator with three InvokeWorkflowFile calls to Workflows/ReceiveOrder.xaml, Workflows/ValidateInventory.xaml, Workflows/ShipOrder.xaml. Each child workflow is a minimal Sequence with a distinct Log Message. Add ARCHITECTURE.md summarizing components and dependencies.

conceptual.expected_response_pattern: Lists the three child workflows, orchestration in Main, and documents architecture in ARCHITECTURE.md.
